Command.Statement: with member [Measures].[Tom1] as ([Measures].[Store Sales] / [Measures].[Unit Sales]), solve_order = 1 set spark1 as ([Time].[1997].[Q1].[1] : [Time].[1997].[Q2].[4]) member [Time].[Time].[Past 4 months] as Generate( [spark1], CAST(Format(([Measures].CurrentMember + 0.0), '###.0#') AS String), ", "), solve_order = 2 select {[Time].[Past 4 months]} ON COLUMNS, {[Measures].[Unit Sales], [Measures].[Tom1]} ON ROWS from [ZFMSALES]
